Volkswagen’s EV battery recall reaches over 85,000, with Audi now included

Volkswagen’s latest recall now extends to Audi, affecting nearly 13,000 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles globally. And just like with the ID.4, owners are being told to limit charging to 80% of the battery’s capacity. Earlier this month, Volkswagen issued a recall with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) impacting 22,524 ID.4 electric SUVs, model years 2023 to 2026.

Prepare To Inhale Way More Methane Than You're Used To

Methane isn't one of those gases we want polluting our air . It traps more heat than carbon dioxide, worsens ground-level ozone, and is associated with increased breathing problems, heart disease, cancer and strokes. When Americans are so unhealthy and we just saw the hottest summer on record, you'd think the government would want less methane in our air, but no.
